rows.subtopic: Being idolised or hated by juniors
rows.description: A junior seems to dislike me and speaks against me in the team. I feel stung. I ask myself what they may have felt from my behaviour, speak with them openly, and hold my standards without needing everyone to like me.

rows.subtopic: Being idolised or hated by juniors
rows.description: Juniors copy my style, phrases, and even my flaws and I feel the weight of being a model. I become more careful about what I show and admit imperfection; I cannot be a saint, but I can be honest.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: dependence, disillusionment, envy, hatred, manipulation, respect

rows.subtopic: Being idolised or hated by juniors
rows.description: A junior keeps running to me for every decision and I feel needed and drained. I ask them what they think, gently step back, and show that my job is to grow their judgment, not their reliance.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: disillusionment, envy, hatred, manipulation, respect, worship

rows.subtopic: Being idolised or hated by juniors
rows.description: A junior resents my faster progress and speaks with a thin smile. I stay generous and share knowledge, do not humiliate them, and notice when their envy turns into sabotage that needs a boundary or manager.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: dependence, disillusionment, hatred, manipulation, respect, worship

rows.subtopic: Being idolised or hated by juniors
rows.description: I notice I enjoy juniors' admiration and use it to get them to work late or protect my image. I stop, be honest about my needs, and see that leadership built on flattery collapses when they mature.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: dependence, disillusionment, envy, hatred, respect, worship

rows.subtopic: Being idolised or hated by juniors
rows.description: I admire a junior for how they handle pressure and learn from them. I tell them so, give them stretch chances, and see that wisdom is not tied to rank or age.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: dependence, disillusionment, envy, hatred, manipulation, worship

rows.subtopic: Being idolised or hated by juniors
rows.description: A junior who once admired me sees my mistake and turns cold. I feel exposed. I own the error without fuss, let them adjust their picture of me, and value being trusted as real over being admired as perfect.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: dependence, envy, hatred, manipulation, respect, worship

rows.description: Feels the years of effort were ignored and burns quietly. Wise move: ask for specific criteria and a timeline, separate the sting from the facts. Immature: sulking, withholding effort, gossiping to peers.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: disillusionment, envy, pride, respect, rivalry, shame

rows.description: A boss who explains honestly why someone else got the role is offering respect. Take the feedback without defensiveness, note what is fair, and ask what would change the decision next cycle.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: disillusionment, envy, pride, resentment, rivalry, shame

rows.description: Watching a peer rise stirs comparison and a sour stomach. Mature response: congratulate honestly, study what they did well, and measure your path against your own goals. Harmful: undermining them or spreading doubts.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: disillusionment, pride, resentment, respect, rivalry, shame
